blockers.label: Requires a server
blockers.message: Use this command in a server where Abbey is installed.

blockers.label: Requires permission
blockers.message: You do not have the required permission for this command. Ask a server manager or open /help for your permitted actions.

blockers.label: Requires presence in the voice channel
blockers.message: Join Abbey's voice channel before using this control. Use /voice status to check the current call.

blockers.label: Requires your own subject
blockers.message: In a DM, use this command for your own memory only.

blockers.label: Needs generation setup
blockers.message: No eligible generation route is configured for this operation. Ask a manager to check provider setup, then retry.

blockers.label: Needs image-description setup
blockers.message: Image description is unavailable. Ask a manager to check image-description provider setup, then retry.

blockers.label: Needs text-extraction setup
blockers.message: Text extraction is unavailable. Ask a manager to check OCR provider setup, then retry.

blockers.label: Images disabled by server policy
blockers.message: Images are disabled for this server. Ask a manager to review /admin vision.

blockers.label: Needs voice setup
blockers.message: Voice is not configured here. Open /voice status for the current state and ask a manager to check setup.

blockers.label: Selected voice mode unavailable
blockers.message: The selected voice mode is unavailable. Open /voice status and ask a manager to check /voice mode.

blockers.label: Needs a member and action
blockers.message: Choose a member and an action, then run /modcall again.

blockers.label: Blocked by role hierarchy
blockers.message: Discord's role hierarchy prevents that action. Choose a permitted target or ask a manager to review the roles.

blockers.label: Readiness unknown; ask a manager to check
blockers.message: Current provider readiness is unknown or needs requalification. Ask a manager to check provider diagnostics, then retry.

blockers.label: Provider busy; retry shortly
blockers.message: The provider is busy. Wait briefly and try again.

blockers.label: Provider unavailable; retry later
blockers.message: The provider is temporarily unavailable. Try again later; if it persists, ask a manager to check provider diagnostics.

ready_message: Available to attempt; execution checks current readiness.
